old_man_sword.name: an old man
old_man_sword.description: A very old man in a plain brown cloak, sitting by a small fire as if he had always been there.

dialog.greeting: It is no road to walk with bare hands.

old_man_bombs.name: an old man
old_man_bombs.description: A very old man with a long white beard, sitting in the dark with his knees drawn up.

dialog.greeting: Most people do not look for the quiet places. Take this, and don't tell the others.
